Predict INACTIVE (below 0.25 x max) when the only item before the coordinator is the text's first token, because then the attended item is the resting token: bare pairs such as 'bread and butter', 'salt and pepper', 'gold, silver', 'cats and dogs.', 'Tom and Mary', and texts with no coordinator at all of 3 tokens or fewer.
